balance.heading: INK wallet
balance.intro: Balances derived from the ledger, in whole INK units. The browser never prices anything nor grants any benefit.

statement.heading: Ledger statement
statement.intro: Entries newest first, in opaque cursor pages.

failure.invalid_cursor: This statement cursor expired. Start again from the first page.
failure.invalid_limit: This page size is not valid. Use a value from 1 to 100.
failure.unauthorized: Sign in to see the wallet.
failure.generic: The wallet could not be loaded. Check and try again.

passes.heading: Arena passes
passes.intro: Contracted rights and real consumption. The browser never grants a pass nor renews any benefit.

checkout.heading: Buy
checkout.intro: Offers from the versioned catalog. Price and destination come from the server; returning alone never grants any benefit.
checkout.redirect_note: You will be taken to the payment page. The account only changes once payment is confirmed.
checkout.paid_note: Payment confirmed. The benefit lands when the confirmation arrives — re-check balance and passes.
checkout.expired_note: This purchase expired and can no longer be paid. Start another one if you want.
checkout.failed_note: This purchase failed and nothing was charged. Try again if you want.
checkout.unavailable: Buying is unavailable right now. Try later.
checkout.failure_invalid: This purchase request is not valid. Check the offer and try again.
checkout.failure_forbidden: This account cannot buy right now.
checkout.failure_rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
checkout.failure_generic: The purchase could not be created. Check and try again.

subscription.heading: Member
subscription.intro: Subscription projection: lifecycle and period, without provider identifiers.
subscription.canceling: It will be canceled at the end of the current period.
subscription.benefit_note: Current and legacy benefits apply as the rules in force declare.
subscription.portal_note: You will be taken to the customer portal. When back, re-check the subscription.
subscription.unavailable: Portal unavailable right now. Try later.
subscription.failure_unauthorized: Sign in to see the subscription.
subscription.failure_no_customer: No billing customer on this account.
subscription.failure_rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
subscription.failure_generic: The subscription could not be loaded. Check and try again.
